title: FOREIGN INVESTMENT

overview: AD Legal advises foreign investors throughout the entire investment lifecycle in Vietnam, from market entry and business establishment to expansion and corporate restructuring. Combining in-depth legal expertise with practical experience working alongside regulatory authorities, we help investors enter and operate in the Vietnamese market efficiently, transparently, and sustainably.

title: MERGERS & ACQUISITIONS / CORPORATE RESTRUCTURING
shortDescription: Strategic legal and financial advisory for M&A transactions and corporate restructuring.
overview: Mergers & Acquisitions and corporate restructuring are among AD Legal's core practice areas. We combine legal expertise with financial insight and transaction strategy to help clients maximize enterprise value while effectively managing legal and commercial risks. Our team supports clients throughout every stage of the transaction—from preparation and deal structuring to completion and post-closing implementation—ensuring both legal certainty and commercial viability.

Beyond traditional legal advisory services, AD Legal also assists clients in preparing investment teasers, introducing opportunities to potential investors, and providing business valuation support to enhance negotiation efficiency and transaction success.

Legal, financial, and tax due diligence
Drafting and negotiating transaction documents
Preparation of investment teasers and company profiles
Business valuation analysis and transaction support
Corporate restructuring and ownership restructuring
Post-closing legal implementation and regulatory procedures

title: EMPLOYMENT & LABOR

We have particular expertise in handling sensitive employment matters, including disciplinary actions, termination of employment, workforce restructuring, and employee grievances. Through a practical and balanced approach that considers the interests of both employers and employees, we help clients minimize disputes and maintain efficient workforce management.

Drawing upon extensive experience advising both domestic and international clients, we provide comprehensive intellectual property solutions—from securing IP rights and developing tailored protection strategies to handling disputes and supporting the commercialization of intellectual property. We work closely with clients to identify legal risks, prevent infringement, and maximize the commercial value of their intellectual property assets.
